title: Conditional κ = 0.00314933 (+0.661%): replace the path caller with a binary query tree
body:
This construction raises **complete conditional κ to 0.00314933**, from 0.003128645 in [PR #6167](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6167): **+0.000020685, about 0.661%**. The native word is unchanged. A binary tree of query suppliers replaces the paired path and changes the complete target/paid distribution. The selected frontier stays unchanged.

Review the [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9894015d6f380206f990ad5fd14bc49bbd26b0d0/research/balanced-query-tree/PROOF.md), [four-field checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9894015d6f380206f990ad5fd14bc49bbd26b0d0/research/balanced-query-tree/module_check.py), [literal caller](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9894015d6f380206f990ad5fd14bc49bbd26b0d0/research/balanced-query-tree/CONTROLLER.json), [complete receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9894015d6f380206f990ad5fd14bc49bbd26b0d0/research/balanced-query-tree/RESULT.json), and [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9894015d6f380206f990ad5fd14bc49bbd26b0d0/research/balanced-query-tree/SOURCES.json).

The new four-field module combines two query suppliers, one paid thin query and two whole idle calls. It returns another query supplier and two independent Gaussian outputs. Root subtree sizes 4, 7 and 8 give 19 full native calls, 16 thin queries and 34 main fields per port. All helper inputs remain arbitrary and independent. The idle work, owned lifetimes, orientation wrappers and ordinary operations are charged.

| Complete calculation | Result |
| --- | ---: |
| Productive fields / paid calls | 14,214 / 70,523 |
| Rank-mass surplus | 808 |
| Raw crossing enclosure | (0.00314934401301, 0.00314934401302) |
| Tested saving / claimed κ | 0.003149335 / 0.00314933 |

**Evidence.** The separate four-field Laurent checker and the emitted 34-field replay pass all 1,156 endpoint entries with distinct stage variables. The unchanged source replay checks all 799 input columns and 638,401 coefficients through a separate transpose. Native phase checks cover 7,904 new caller contacts and every main/idle target. Two rational moment engines agree; the new completion parameters, uniform compiler and all 54 strict plus four functional outer predicates pass. The retained BIT saving is 0.0034. Controls reject missing paid work, a missing central translation, wrong query orientation, the source completion cutoff and insufficient BIT saving.

Both registered modes passed on Python 3.12.13. Committed bytes, execute modes and the official export inventory passed. The full optimized replay also passed from a read-only export with no Git on PATH; hashes and modes stayed unchanged. A one-byte source mutation was rejected before import. The [validation record](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9894015d6f380206f990ad5fd14bc49bbd26b0d0/research/balanced-query-tree/VALIDATION.md) identifies the tested scientific commit; the final commit changes only that record. [Hosted CI](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41372308542) is pending; its planner is running the repository onboarding tests. No hosted scientific pass is claimed.

Reproduce with Python 3.12 and its standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/balanced-query-tree --check-only
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/balanced-query-tree
```

Expected scientific marker:

```text
PASS_BALANCED_QUERY_TREE_KAPPA_00314933
```

**Scope.** This is an author-checked conditional construction. Five inherited assumptions remain: native all-column implementation, owned erasure, uniform compiler, precision/tape cost and analytic recovery. The uniform word and rounded multiplier are not materialized. Independent scientific acceptance, proof-kernel verification, global optimality and a practical speedup are not claimed. Full-history ancestry preflight is unavailable in the shallow checkout; exact source bytes and the immediate base are checked.

**Provenance and credit.** Base: [canonical main 626e936](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/commit/626e936ce4d61f2584316914fc71baf96940c512), priority revision 8. All 18 consumed source files match [PR #6167](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6167) at `564a076b113621a93edc4e39968ee4e4a8c9caf0` byte-for-byte. Cinna Davis @1337isnot1337 supplies the query-thinned path and thin-query interface in the [PR #4470](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4470) lineage. Ali Romman @aliromman supplies the [all-forward native binding](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e2a6cce2f9db5a2c5f9714f4b9e5292dd3a10581/research/p104-productive-controller/PROOF.md) in [PR #5544](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5544) and the retained-operand source. DreamingOfClouds @DreamingOfClouds supplies the preceding local-word changes in [PR #6144](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6144). All earlier native, helper, recursion, compiler, BIT and outer credits remain in [NOTICE](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9894015d6f380206f990ad5fd14bc49bbd26b0d0/research/balanced-query-tree/NOTICE) and the authenticated sources.
